content.welcomeBlurb: Glimmer is an Roblox booststrapper! This onboard will guide you to setup Glimmer on Android.
content.shizukuBlurb: Glimmer needs the Shizuku service to work with Roblox
content.shizukuStep2: Start it with wireless debugging (Android 11 and up) or with adb from a computer
content.shizukuStep3: Come back here, Glimmer checks by itself!
content.permissionBlurb: Shizuku asks you to confirm that Glimmer may use it
content.robloxBlurb: Glimmer needs the Roblox app installed on this phone
content.doneBlurb: Shizuku and Roblox are set up. Pick a game and play.
